meta.axes: x increases east (right), y increases north (up)
meta.north: ASSUMED. The user says the south ends of the two vertical wings (703A and 706A) face the front of the Tech Park; north is taken as the opposite end.
meta.scale_status: ESTIMATED. No measured distances exist. Corridor width 2.4 m, passage width 3.0 m, door 0.9 m and all room sizes are assumed. Spine-to-spine length of the lab passage (46 m) is a guess built from the user's survey notes (35 to 40 m) and symmetry; it may be too long.
meta.shape: Two symmetrical vertical wings (west spine x=-9, east spine x=+37, mirror line x=14) joined by one horizontal lab passage at y=0. Each wing has four rooms, a lift lobby and stairs at the join.
